label: Resin
rs.field.hollow: Hollow it, with a vent hole
rs.resin.note: Exposure and lift numbers are a starting point for this kind of resin, not your resin’s. Use the exposure test below to find yours.
rs.printer.note: Screen {w} × {h} pixels, {x} × {y} mm. These are the maker’s published sizes: check yours and edit them in Custom.
rs.supports.note: The part is lifted on a raft, and every flat underside, overhang and floating piece gets thin pillars. These supports are new and have not been tried on a printer: look at the layers before you print.
rs.noformat: No file format for this printer is added yet. Add one below.
rs.format.unlisted: {printer} is not listed as reading this format. Use it only if you know your printer does.
rs.format.options: If your printer refuses the file, change one of these and save again, then tell us which worked.
rs.preview.stale: The bed or the settings changed since the last slice. Preview layers again.
rs.preview.canvas: The layer as the screen will show it
rs.stats: {layers} layers, about {time}, {ml} mL of resin ({g} g, about {cost}).
rs.stats.supports: {n} supports: {raft} on the raft, {model} on the part.
rs.empty: Put something on the bed first.
rs.off: Off the screen: {names}. Move it inside the dashed outline.
rs.confirm: Save {format}: {layers} layers, about {time}, {ml} mL of resin.
rs.confirm.untested: This file has been read back by CadCraft only. It has not been loaded on a printer yet: check the layers and run your first print by hand.
rs.saved: Saved {name}: about {time}, {ml} mL of resin. Copy it to the printer.
rs.untested: New in this build. The files have not been through a printer yet.
rs.warn.skipped: {n} pieces ({share}% of the shape) are not closed solids and were left out.
rs.warn.skipped_one: One piece ({share}% of the shape) is not a closed solid and was left out.
rs.warn.sheets: {n} flat panels were given a thickness so they print.
rs.warn.floating: The shape floated above the plate; it was lowered to it.
rs.warn.islands: {n} pieces have nothing under them and will fall off. Turn supports on, or tilt the shape.
rs.warn.overhangs: Overhangs on {n} layers are steeper than the angle set, with no supports.
rs.warn.nodrain: {n} closed cavities could not get a hole. Make the wall thinner or the hole smaller.
rs.fail.open: None of the pieces is a closed solid.
rs.fail.bed: It does not fit the screen or the height.
rs.fail.write: The file could not be written. {why}
